$schema_comment: docs/execution/automation/ESCALATION_POLICY.json — expensive reasoning is reserved for listed triggers. Quota exhaustion defers, never fails.
quota_rule: When escalation is required but Codex is quota-limited, record ESCALATION_DEFERRED_QUOTA, preserve the exact escalation packet, and stop the architecture-dependent task safely. Never mark the repository broken, never mark orchestration failed, never substitute a weaker model for architecture, never probe the quota in a loop.
packet_contract: The escalation packet carries facts only (checkpoint, SHAs, invariants, failure signature, attempts, files, tests, hosted IDs, excerpts, hypotheses, exact question). The reasoning session reads, reasons, returns a decision/contract, and exits; it does not wait on builds.
